requirements.name: Continuous zoom pan rotate with keyboard alternatives
requirements.gap: B1.8 provides keyboard/pointer interaction on a raster image. F3 already provides a stronger OpenSeadragon deep-zoom source viewer, but it is not yet wired into the managed-runtime professional workbench client.

requirements.name: Drawing-first visual hierarchy
requirements.gap: The audited B1.8 surface still places governance/provenance content and forms before sustained engineering drawing work. The new kernel deliberately does not claim UI completion.

requirements.name: True technical vector representation from governed document geometry
requirements.gap: The projection kernel now has a normalized scene envelope and reuses F6 structural projections, but current runtime scenes do not yet materialize Dual Vector Agreement document primitives/text into the technical scene.

requirements.name: Selectable technical objects and hit testing
requirements.gap: F6 has selectable SVG members and the kernel has stable typed scene object ids, but the new professional client/hit-testing layer is not yet integrated.

requirements.name: Object-anchored editable recognized text and values
requirements.gap: WorkingEdit is now a validated object-bound non-canonical delta that preserves its base value and rejects governed structural targets. RecognizedText/Dimension objects and their in-place UI are not yet materialized in the live workbench.

requirements.name: Provenance-backed source-to-technical registration transform
requirements.gap: RegistrationTransform now has explicit coordinate spaces, states, revision binding, control-correspondence requirements and fail-closed validation. The real project still has no VERIFIED source-to-technical registration, so spatial synchronization remains unavailable.

requirements.name: Synchronized split navigation guarded by valid registration
requirements.gap: Semantic synchronization remains available through explicit EvidenceLink/F6 relations. The kernel now rejects SPATIAL_LOCKED unless registration is VERIFIED and revision-matched; the actual synchronized multi-viewport client is still pending.

requirements.name: Overlay comparison mode with opacity/alignment controls
requirements.gap: The kernel now fail-closes an OVERLAY request without verified registration, but no registered overlay renderer/client controls are implemented.

requirements.name: Layer-capable technical scene
requirements.gap: A typed scene envelope and object families now exist, but Dual Vector Agreement primitives, recognized text/dimensions, issues and working-edit visual deltas are not yet composed into one rendered layer stack.

requirements.name: Graphically anchored ReadingIssue workflow
requirements.gap: ReadingIssue now requires an object, non-viewport geometry, or explicit EvidenceLink anchor and cannot authorize canonical write. Graphical markers, issue list and inspector workflow remain to be implemented in the client.

requirements.name: Progressive disclosure Work -> Evidence -> Provenance
requirements.gap: The design contract is versioned, but the audited live surface still exposes internal provenance/governance directly in the primary workspace.

requirements.name: Multiresolution or tiled large-drawing rendering architecture
requirements.gap: The scene projection now references the exact F3 DZI asset for each task, but the managed Render runtime does not yet serve/bind that immutable tile pyramid as the primary Workbench source viewport.

requirements.name: Dedicated maintainable workbench client/state architecture
requirements.gap: A dedicated deterministic kernel now owns scene validation, view-state resolution, registration guards, WorkingEdit and ReadingIssue semantics. The final typed browser client/event/state implementation is still pending, so the audited monolithic B1.8 UI is not accepted.

requirements.name: Desktop-first engineering layout with tablet/narrow review modes
requirements.gap: Device-mode behavior is now explicitly designed, but no final professional client implements those state maps.

requirements.name: Saved/reusable professional view state
requirements.gap: The kernel can resolve display/sync state, but no revision-bound reusable View object yet persists viewport position, zoom, layers, annotations and selection.

requirements.name: Professional engineering-task HVA protocol
requirements.gap: The professional find-orient-compare-identify-edit-verify-resolve protocol is versioned but intentionally not executable until implementation entry criteria are satisfied.
